title: HeightSMP
description: HeightSMP is where you get smaller for kills and bigger on death - like lifesteal!
body:
HeightSMP is a plugin where players grow in size when they die or shrink when they get a kill getting a strategic advantage to be harder to hit and easier to hide but for those who died alot will be more obvios and easier to hit.

On kill you reduce by 0.25 and on death you increase by 0.5 so your insetivised to get more kills - the max sizes are: 0.01 and 20 blocks.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
